serviceName: Your TSoftCloud app at the domain itself
description: Points the domain itself, such as example.com, to TSoftCloud's edge with one A record, because a CNAME cannot sit at the apex of a domain. The IP is TSoftCloud's production edge address, fixed in this template: a change of that address needs a new template version.
variableDescription: None. The record is fixed to the production edge address 152.53.83.88.
